name: Kurage: Love in the Deathless City
source:
Kurage: Love in the Deathless City is an 18+ horror mystery eroguro visual novel about two immortal* guys in a cyberpunk dystopia trying to solve the mysterious case of Tsubasa Akizawa, a celebrity who committed suicide under suspicious circumstances 5 years before the story began. 

It follows Keith, Tsubasa's childhood friend and former lover who's still deep in mourning, and Kurage, an android replica of Tsubasa created a few months after his death by a company aiming to capitalize on his popularity. After a chance meeting, they realize that Tsubasa's "suicide" was actually a murder and resolve to find the truth together. 

Their investigation only becomes more complicated when Kurage discovers that Keith is an immortal cyborg capable of regenerating, and that his scrambled memories might hint at an even deeper and more dangerous conspiracy.

[From [url=https://zorinaart.itch.io/kurage-love-in-the-deathless-city]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《水母：不死之城的爱恋》是一部18+赛博朋克反乌托邦题材的恐怖悬疑猎奇视觉小说，讲述两名“不死*”青年联手追查5年前人气名人秋泽翼离奇自杀一案的故事。

故事围绕着至今仍深陷丧侣之痛的秋泽翼青梅竹马兼前恋人基思，以及翼死后数月由某家公司为榨取其剩余人气而制造的仿生人复制品“水母”展开。一次偶然的相遇让两人意识到，翼当年的“自杀”实为一桩谋杀案，于是决定携手查明真相。

然而随着调查深入，水母发现基思竟是一名拥有再生能力的不死改造人，而他那支离破碎的记忆背后，似乎还隐藏着一场更加深不可测、危机四伏的惊天阴谋。

[摘自[url=https://zorinaart.itch.io/kurage-love-in-the-deathless-city]itch.io[/url]]
